full_judgment: Latifur Rahman, J.: This appeal by special leave by the pre-emptee is directed against the judgment of the High Court Division, Sylhet, in Civil Revision No. 1391 of 1978 discharging the Rule and upholding the orders of the Courts below arising out of an application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950.
